$comment: Source of truth for the Dataverse schema (plan section 5). scripts/provision-dataverse.py creates it inside the solution; scripts/verify-solution.py proves it. Option values are option_value_prefix * 10000 + position, so only ever append options, never reorder.

global_choices.name: vz_judgment
global_choices.description: Outcome of a data right or contract term, shared by the AI judgment and the reviewer judgment.

tables.name: vz_contractquestion
tables.description: User-owned asynchronous questions about one contract. Never updates extraction or reviewer fields.

columns.name: vz_context
columns.description: Extraction read through the asking user's data service; the flow never fetches contract text as its admin.

tables.name: vz_contract
tables.description: A contract document that is analyzed against the review checklist.

primary.name: vz_name
primary.description: File name of the contract document.

columns.name: vz_vendor
columns.description: Vendor or counterparty. Promoted from findings for views.

columns.name: vz_viziententity
columns.description: Vizient contracting entity. Promoted from findings for views.

columns.name: vz_contractidentifier
columns.description: Contract or agreement number. Promoted from findings for views.

columns.name: vz_document
columns.description: Copy of the PDF. The evidence viewer reads this.

columns.name: vz_sharepointurl
columns.description: Link to the source document.

columns.name: vz_sharepointitemid
columns.description: SharePoint item or file id. The Code App reads the PDF through the SharePoint connector.

columns.name: vz_hasparentreference
columns.description: True if the AI found a parent or related agreement reference.

columns.name: vz_completeness
columns.description: Found count divided by total count, times 100.

columns.name: vz_rawresult
columns.description: Raw analyzer JSON for debugging and re-processing.

columns.name: vz_documenttext
columns.description: Complete synthetic document extraction with verified page boundaries. Separate from the reduced debugging result.

columns.name: vz_indexversion
columns.description: SHA-256 of the complete page-marked document indexed for Q&A.

tables.name: vz_checklistitem
tables.description: Configuration: one row per item on the contract review checklist.

columns.name: vz_key
columns.description: Stable key that matches the analyzer field, for example Right_AIML.

columns.name: vz_definition
columns.description: Shown as a tooltip in the viewer.

columns.name: vz_hasjudgment
columns.description: True for data rights.

tables.name: vz_finding
tables.description: One row per contract and checklist item: what the AI found and what the reviewer decided.

primary.name: vz_name
primary.description: Contract name and checklist item label.

columns.name: vz_aivalue
columns.description: Extracted value or summary.

columns.name: vz_clause
columns.description: Verbatim quote from the contract.

columns.name: vz_page
columns.description: First page of the source.

columns.name: vz_sourceregions
columns.description: JSON array of page and polygon regions, in the units the analyzer returns (inches for PDF).

columns.name: vz_reviewervalue
columns.description: Reviewer correction. The original AI value is never overwritten.

relationships.name: vz_contractquestion_contract
relationships.description: Only this contract is in scope. Dataverse enforces append-to access on the parent.

relationships.name: vz_contract_parentcontract
relationships.description: Manual link: amendment to SOW to MSA.

relationships.name: vz_finding_contract
relationships.description: Parent contract. Deleting the contract deletes its findings.

relationships.name: vz_finding_checklistitem
relationships.description: The checklist item this finding answers.
